address: Passage Darracq, 1 rue du Hédas, Pau, 64000, France
bio: Two friends from Pau have hit the jackpot with this picturesque location, hidden away in a narrow little stepped street in one of the town's oldest neighbourhoods. Aromatic herbs, spices, house-made infused vinegars, citrus fruits, authentic jus – a wealth of flavours that come through in dishes that are brimming with original ideas and childhood memories....
